description: A gray plastic bin with several ice cubes sits on the table, with a small yellow cup nearby and a purple scoop on the right. The right hand grasps the purple scoop and slides it into the bin to gather ice while the left hand steadies the bin, then the right hand lifts the scoop and moves it toward the yellow cup as the left hand brings the cup up under the scoop; the right hand tips the scoop and dumps the ice into the cup before pulling the scoop away.
